subject: Re: Proposal — temporary liquidity bridge and invoice accelerator
messages:
From: Emily Foster <emily.foster@orionhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orionhealth.com>, accounts-payable@orionhealth.com
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary extension / VAT reclaim timing for Q1 invoices

Hi Stephanie / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. We just closed our Q1 close and have a short cash timing mismatch driven by intercompany VAT reclaim delays across our EU entity. We have three Redwood invoices from Apr–May (attached) that would normally be Net30, but our Treasury is asking for a short-term solution while VAT reclaims clear (expected 6–8 weeks).

Options they'd accept: a brief Net45/Net60 for the Apr invoices, or an early-pay / 2% acceleration fee to move payment forward. There is also a cap: any credit extension needs to be explicit and limited to EUR 150k until our next remittance cycle.

Can Redwood offer anything there? We value the integration but need a pragmatic path so we don't hit late fees with our vendors. If it helps, PO# ORN-8342 is attached to each invoice.

Attachments: Orion_Invoices_Q1-2026.pdf (3 pages)

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Foster
Head of Finance Operations
Orion Health
--
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Foster <emily.foster@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 10:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary extension / VAT reclaim timing for Q1 invoices

Emily —

Appreciate the detail and the PO. We can absolutely help avoid vendor friction. Two options we can offer quickly that balance risk and cost:

1) Temporary liquidity bridge (Redwood Advance): Redwood provides a short-term credit line to cover up to EUR 150,000 of invoices for 6 weeks. We charge a one-time 1.75% facility fee and require a signed temporary credit agreement. Partial invoices remain due per normal terms if VAT is settled early.

2) Invoice accelerator: Redwood can accept an early-pay at a 2% discount to move payment date up immediately to settle in the next 5 business days. This would be paid out to Redwood's bank and removes the need for any credit exposure.

If neither is ideal, we can also move the terms on a per-invoice basis to Net45 (no fee) but that requires PO acknowledgement and explicitly capped exposure to EUR 150k.

I copied Rishi from Finance to confirm accounting and MFT requirements. If you're good with 1) we'll circulate the Temporary_Credit_Agreement_Draft and run a quick credit check (standard, ~24h). If 2) sounds better, I can get the accelerator payout scheduled.

Proposed next step: quick call Monday to select approach and confirm wiring/DocuSign details.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Proposed_Payment_Schedule.xlsx

Emily —

Quick note from Finance:
- We can sign a temporary credit agreement for up to EUR 150,000 for 6 weeks. We will need a completed credit application (I attached the draft) and confirmation of the invoiced entities (to validate VAT reclaim flow).
- VAT evidence required: copy of VAT reclaim filings or the 2-month VAT ledger showing the expected reclaim date. Without that, we cannot move to Net60.
- Accounting treatment: facility fees will be invoiced separately and are due on the next billing cycle.

If you go with the invoice accelerator option, Accounts Payable will need a single wire instruction and we will mark the invoices as paid on receipt.

Two quick asks for the Monday call:
1) Can you confirm which legal entity (Orion Health Ltd vs Orion Health BV) is the invoiced party?
2) Any internal approvals needed to sign the Temporary_Credit_Agreement_Draft?

I'll prepare the DocuSign envelope and circularize signatures once we confirm path.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa / Stephanie —

We confirm the invoiced legal entity is Orion Health BV (NL). VAT reclaim evidence: I attached the VAT ledger and the reclaim submission PDF (internal). We'll be able to finalize approvals by EOD Monday.

Decision from Treasury: we prefer the Temporary liquidity bridge (option 1) to avoid losing the 2% to fast-pay; the EUR 150k cap is acceptable. We'll sign the draft agreement. Two clarifications:
1) Can Redwood allow a single check-in at week 3 to confirm the reclaim progress (non-binding)?
2) Will facility fees be rebated if VAT clears earlier and we pay early?

If you can answer those, we'll circulate the signed credit app and the signed draft to you by Monday afternoon.

Best,
Emily

Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary extension / VAT reclaim timing for Q1 invoices

Emily / team —

Thanks for the docs and for choosing the Temporary liquidity bridge. To answer your questions:

1) Check-in at week 3: yes — we will schedule a non-binding status call at 3 weeks to confirm VAT progress and the expected settlement date. This is purely informational; the underlying payment terms remain per the credit agreement.

2) Facility fee rebate: if the invoices covered by the facility are paid in full earlier than the 6-week window (VAT clears and you remit), Redwood will rebate 50% of the facility fee prorated based on remaining days. Example: 1.75% fee for 42 days; if you repay on day 21, rebate = 0.875% (pro rata).

Next steps (action items):
- Stephanie: circulate DocuSign with Temporary_Credit_Agreement_Draft and the credit application to Emily.
- Marissa: run the light credit check (internal) — estimate 24h to complete.
- Emily: return signed credit app + signed draft by EOD Monday (we received the VAT ledger, that suffices).

Once we have the signed docs we'll generate the specific facility account and post wiring instructions. We'll also attach a payment schedule to the DocuSign envelope so AP has one-click wiring options.

I'll log the temporary facility under deal DL-2026-078 in our billing system; this will create a temporary credit cap of EUR 150,000.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Finance (Receivables)
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Temporary_Credit_Agreement_Draft.pdf, Redwood_Proposed_Payment_Schedule.xlsx
